japanese: アイテム図鑑 (category row + subtitle)

english: Records the effects of every item: arms, armor, accessories, cures, magic stones and tools. Adventurers get a blank one free; alchemy fills it in.
Given to Doohan adventurers. Magic and alchemy record the abilities of monsters you defeat. Fighting a foe often unlocks deeper analysis.
Lore on the Alleido and the Alleido Stone, said to seal its power. Take it to certain people to expand it.
Lists arms and items at Doohan's shop and goods you sell back. Magic keeps it updated.
A ledger of aid at sign-up.
A guide for Doohan newcomers and merchants: shops, services, registration and adventurer etiquette. Kept current by the Benoan guild.
A greeting from someone met below.
